basics.name: Arnav Rastogi

work.name: Hapticware Intelligence
highlights: Built an agentic swarm framework with LangGraph to orchestrate and manage a fleet of 30+ agents across complex, decomposable tasks.
Engineered RAG over a 100+ table production database, cutting chatbot query response time by 30-40% and auto-generating result graphs.
Developed backend APIs for a digital-signer product and its admin portal, alongside supporting production services.

work.name: Abhay Travels
highlights: Researched demand-forecasting models for time-series data, engineering 15+ features to capture seasonal and non-linear trends.
Built a predictive pipeline with CatBoost that beat baseline ARIMA models on RMSE across 5 years of historical booking data.

work.name: AMR India
highlights: Forecast article-specific demand cycles across 200+ HSN codes from ~50K port transaction records over 4 years, informing quarterly procurement planning.

courses: Core focus on Deep Learning, Linear Algebra, and Statistical Inference.
Advanced training in Probabilistic Modeling, Machine Learning foundations, and Time Series Analysis.

projects.name: LLM Lab
highlights: Built a character-level GPT from scratch in PyTorch to study the internal dynamics of Multi-Head Attention and Transformer blocks.
Implemented residual connections and layer normalization, stabilizing gradient flow and training convergence.

projects.name: Lenia & Conway's Game of Life
highlights: Simulated continuous-state artificial life via Gaussian kernel evolution and non-linear PDEs, probing emergent dynamics at real-time high resolution.

projects.name: rCiv (Knowledge Commons)

Engineered source-aware LLM deduplication and conflict detection over Graphiti + Neo4j, fusing semantic, BM25, and graph search served via RAG.

projects.name: ARC-Engine

Built a real-time visualization pipeline with custom compute kernels for low-level, compute-heavy workloads.

projects.name: Tailor (AI Framework)

projects.name: Sudoku Solver (Algorithms)
